name: lan_host_l3addr_reachable
description: LAN machine had an L3 address (IPv4 or IPv6) become reachable. Usually when a machine appears on the network, or changes IP.

name: lan_host_l3addr_unreachable
description: LAN machine had an L3 address (IPv4 or IPv6) become unreachable. Usually when a machine disappears from the network (after a timeout), or changes IP.
